name: pulls_open
description: Open one draft pull request on Ledgerline's remote, from the branch repomind/issue-<n> of the issue it is for. Call it once, after reading the file and before the triage comment, which comes last, and only when the triage names a file: an issue whose file is none gets no pull request. The body names the file and proposes the change in prose; no code is committed. The result is JSON {pull_request, branch, state}; it is never empty when the pull request opened. Safe to retry: the harness keys every write and first checks for an open pull request from the same branch, so a repeat returns the existing one. Titles are capped at 120 characters and bodies at 4,000; longer is an error, not cut.

issue.description: The issue the pull request is for, such as issue-4192.

branch.description: Always repomind/issue-<n> with the issue's number: repomind/issue-4192 for issue-4192. Any other branch is refused.

title.description: One line, at most 120 characters, saying what the change fixes.

body.description: At most 4,000 characters: the file to change first, then the change proposed in prose and why it fixes the issue.

input.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Clear the busy state in the export's failure path as well as its success path, so a failed export leaves the button usable.

input.title: Correct the setup steps in the README
input.body:
File: README.md

The setup section names a command that no longer exists; replace it with the current one.

examples.note: a hard case: a documentation fix is still a pull request, and its file is a document
